name: Jurassic Ark — Spawn-Tor

placementPolicy.preview-terrain: reference-only; NEVER place this plane with fill

placementPolicy.jungle: avoid existing builds and preserve clear path

references.type: primary production account and 1992 set construction photographs
references.observations: Tall concrete-clad pylons taper outward toward their bases; shallow curved spanning beam; straight approach road.

references.type: original 1993 film frame hosted by an image database; supplemental visual check
references.observations: Two lines JURASSIC / PARK, red fill and yellow outline, dark beam, four flames per pylon, open timber leaves.

notes: Gate coordinates are local. The 207 original ground cells and the concept scene are retained from v4.
A permanently open 13 × 15 passage, two timber leaves, ten fixed vanilla text displays and eight campfires.
Dimensions and material choices are a block-scale interpretation of the 1993 gate. The custom sign reads JURASSIC ARK.
